synopsis.text:
Mio works at her family’s Chinese restaurant. She spends her days cherishing both the place she calls home and her deep, long-standing feelings for her childhood friend, Tetta. Then, one day—while delivering an order to the local shopping district’s community hall—she is confronted by Goto, the building’s landlord, regarding her overdue rent. He proposes that she "grow up" (become an adult) if she wants to avoid being evicted. With that, Goto’s predatory hands descend upon her, ruthlessly violating her body and stripping away her innocence…!?

(Source: Lune-soft, translated)
